source: training_data/E (20,000 rows) minus its 1,327 numeric_form rows and 681 spelling/format CORRECT rows, plus 1,939 batch-F rows (data/generated/batch_F); val and val_eval copied unchanged from E

changes.why: 79 % of E's numeric_form rows sat on stems that never state a required form, so they contradicted the format/math_equiv rows; E scored 35.2 % on benchmark-v2 numeric_form. Every batch-F stem states its form in words (lowest terms, simplest radical form, in terms of π, scientific notation, ...).
changes.batch_F_rows: 700 new problems by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, prompt F_author_v1); GPT (gpt-5) solved each blind and graded each row label-blind; kept only rows where GPT agreed with the key and the label and did not flag; unreduced-π-coefficient rows dropped where the stem does not ask for simplest form. See data/generated/batch_F/LOG.md.

selection.note: row i of selection.jsonl describes row i of train.jsonl; lane F rows are batch F, the rest are E's selection entries unchanged

recommended_training: E's hyperparameters (LoRA r=16, alpha=32, 3 epochs, peak lr 1e-4) so that F - E measures the data change alone; owner decision 3 in plan/dataset_F_plan.md
